authority: Latest explicit user instruction + ADHOMS Ver1 current Notion hub
change_rule: A locked decision may be changed only by a new explicit user decision that identifies the old lock as superseded. Implementation convenience, framework defaults, old branches, tests, or assistant inference cannot override it.

locks.decision: The FEED is read downward as a chronological observation log. Within a month, older weeks stay above and newly arrived weekly observations append below what the player has already read. A week advance must not make the player search upward for new content.
locks.startup_rule: Initial rendering and saved-week restoration are not week advances. Preserve the opening on fresh entry; only an explicit weekly advance may scroll to that week's new observations.

locks.decision: Do not force FEED posts into a uniform short/two-line style. Length follows speaker and content. Some residents may be terse; experts, staff, officials, media, and people with something substantive to explain may write substantially longer posts. X-like means one-column/social-feed presentation, not a uniform character limit.
Keep the established portrait smartphone one-column FEED direction unless the user explicitly changes it. Do not reinterpret it into desktop split panes or a different primary navigation model.
There is no Follow mechanic in current Ver1. Lottery-distributed observation terminals and the observation model replace it.
Plus/minus are internal observation weights, not public approval/disapproval or popularity voting.
Do not require monthly value sliders. The rhythm is monthly observation, optional/meaningful quarterly judgment, and annual reporting.
Ver1 prioritizes story, character attachment, causality, and Ver2 continuity supported by lightweight simulation. Full high-granularity resident simulation is not a Ver1 prerequisite.
Ending order is administrative review with T-0WA continuation declaration, then private TOWA/Kiso conversation, then quiet Directive 4, then epilogue.
Do not reveal the full T-0WA naming/voice origin in Ver1. The university-festival TOWA/Kiso encounter may be revealed at the ending, but the private T-0WA origin remains withheld.
BRINE individual names remain unresolved. Use BRINE as the band reference and do not silently choose among conflicting name sets.
locks.portrayal_rule: User 2026-09-27 / hub section 23 requests individual speakers. The shared given name Toru (透), university-classmate relationship and equipment-repair history may be shown without choosing the disputed surname/instrument assignment. Other unresolved personal names remain unchosen; BRINE remains the band name, not an individual dialogue speaker.

locks.decision: Separate from the opening explanation, the first April FEED begins with staff introductions, terminal checks and conversational guidance before resident observations. Use current character roles and voices. Practice weights stay internal and do not start unrelated town research. Do not repeat this opening in later months or years or require tutorial clicks to progress.
locks.source: Explicit user requests 2026-09-26; current Notion hub sections 18–20

locks.decision: Final-rain personal outcomes are fixed convergence: 高倉真知 survives without serious injury, but 高倉味噌店 suffers major loss to equipment, kura/storage and inventory and business continuity remains at risk. 柴垣晃生 survives, is stranded during evacuation/withdrawal from the Hassaku sumo side, is injured in that process, and is not immediately able to return to competition.
locks.interpretation_rule: Evacuation risk remains a variable exposure metric and must not overwrite these adopted outcomes. Do not invent exact diagnosis, surgery, monetary loss, destroyed inventory counts, or exact return date unless separately decided.
